title: Oversight Board Org Chart
description: Five board seats, what each one does, and how a board sits above day-to-day sessions without running them.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Establishing an Oversight Board and Inventory System

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given the five named seats on a coding club's oversight board, the learner identifies each seat's core responsibility and how the board as a whole relates to day-to-day operations.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click any seat for its core responsibility; two distinct routes connect the board to the people it serves
pedagogical.assessment: Name a seat and ask for its core responsibility; ask which seat hears from mentors directly.
